pci.label: PCI address
pci.description: The GPU's PCI address, for example 0000:03:00.0. Find it with: readlink -f /sys/class/drm/card*/device

label.label: Label
label.description: Text shown before the usage, for example 680M

interval.label: Update interval (ms)
interval.description: How often the card is read

hide_when_asleep.label: Hide while asleep
hide_when_asleep.description: Remove the widget from the bar while the GPU is in runtime suspend, so it only shows up when the GPU wakes
